avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces diphenoxylate levels and efficacy; may increase diarrhea recurrence
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced antidiarrheal effect

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; additive CNS depression with diphenoxylate's atropine component
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; select alternative hepatoprotective supplement if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may moderately increase diphenoxylate levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic and CNS effects; use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Anticholinergic herbs (Belladonna, Henbane)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects with atropine component; increased constipation/urinary retention risk
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for anticholinergic toxicity symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases diphenoxylate bioavailability and atropine levels; risk of adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet during diphenoxylate therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase absorption rate and peak levels of diphenoxylate
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal timing; counsel on uniform food intake patterns

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; may potentiate anticholinergic effects
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; counsel on CNS impairment risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of opioid toxicity (respiratory depression, drowsiness, miosis) and anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia), especially with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Assess hydration status and electrolytes during extended use due to antidiarrheal potency.
